{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== '''Exo Follower''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had decent health and fast speed. On some waves, it was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning towers needed hidden detection to target it. ==Logbook Description== "''Once given a soul by Lefty, the Exo Follower became bonded to the [[Exo Guard]]. While created to perform a role, when it's not acting it will happily follow around anyone it finds interesting. Sometimes the Exo Follower will antagonize Narrator, but it only reminds him of the Old World days.''" ==Appearance== The '''Exo Follower''' is entirely covered up in black and purple armor, consisting of shoes, padding around thighs, shoulder-pads, shoulder-pads and helmet. On its arms, it has black glove and a chain wrapped around its right arm. It also has a purple belt, two buttons on its helmet and a button in the middle of its torso. It has two walking animations it can use. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here, as they can kill it even when it is [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once, though do note that they will be partially or fully unable to damage them when [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. *Later on, the '''Exo Follower''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. **Do note however that the [[Ranger]] and to path [[Pursuit]] are unable to target the '''Exo Follower''' while it is [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. *As the '''Exo Follower''' is quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to slow it down. **Stalling towers with hidden detection, like the [[Freezer]], are especially useful, as they can slow it down even when [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]].
